title: Melaka Harmony Trail
description: Walk along famous Jalan Tukang Emas and Heeren Street to discover how Malay, Chinese, and Indian Muslim traditions flourished side-by-side in harmony for three centuries.

title: Sovereigns & Sieges: Sultanate to Colonial Forts
tagline: From Mansur Shah's Golden Age to European Bastions
description: Trace the dramatic shifts of power in Southeast Asia: starting from the nail-less wooden Malay royal palace up to the Portuguese fortress gate and Dutch governance seat.

title: Living Straits Heritage: Shophouses & Ancestral Mansions
tagline: Craftsmen, Antiques, and Baba-Nyonya Living Opulence
description: An intimate journey through Straits-Chinese architecture, delicate beaded shoe craftsmanship, ancestral shrines, and aromatic Nyonya culinary traditions.
